map.name: Ulmgard
map.setting: a frozen fort on a mountain pass
map.trouble: The Necromancer Ostrag has raised the dead in the Glacier Tombs above the pass, and his Undead hold the high road beyond the Upper Gate.

guard_bark.specifics: Hask at the Low Gate of Ulmgard, pointing newcomers up to Warden Galmor; later the Upper Gate is open.

first.speaker: Hask
first.text: I thought you lowlanders could take a little cold. Try stamping your feet.

again.speaker: Hask
again.text: Hurry! Warden Galmor is expecting you up in his hall at the top of the keep. There's a stair behind the stables that will lead you straight to him.

later.speaker: Hask
later.text: Welcome back to Ulmgard. The Upper Gate is open to you now.

bounty_offer.specifics: Hedda's Pa comes home from patrol tomorrow, and the White Wolves of the Ice Caves dragged off his lucky long johns from the east wall.

offer.speaker: Hedda
offer.text:
Kind sir! Kind sir, wait! I'm in terrible trouble! Pa's lucky long johns are gone! I hung them on the east wall to dry and a pack of White Wolves made off with them!

Pa comes home from patrol tomorrow and he won't stand a single watch without them. These mangy beasts are worse than a blizzard!

Please, go down to their den below the east wall and get rid of those wolves. I'll pay you well for it.

reminder.speaker: Hedda
reminder.text: One of the soldiers -- with a nasty cough -- says he saw those wolves slink into the caves under the wall. Maybe Pa's long johns are down there too!

completion.speaker: Hedda
completion.text:
You did it?! The wolves are really gone? And Pa's long johns too! Oh, thank you, thank you!

Here, take this gold, with my thanks. Pa will never know a thing!

journal.text: Clear the White Wolves out of the Ice Caves.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Tibbet the furrier's shop is ruined since rogues took his magic shears to the old toll house down the west road.

offer.speaker: Tibbet
offer.text:
Ruined! I'm ruined! Rogues broke into my shop last night and took my magic shears! Without them I can't cut a single fur, and the whole garrison is waiting on winter coats!

Those thieves are holed up in the old toll house down the west road. Will you get my shears back for me, young sir?

refusal.speaker: Tibbet
refusal.text: Come back when you feel braver.

reminder.speaker: Tibbet
reminder.text: Those rogues must be laughing at me right now!

completion.speaker: Tibbet
completion.text:
My shears! Oh, my beautiful shears! Now I can get back to work!

I can't offer much till the coats are sold, but take these boots. A token of my appreciation!

after.speaker: Tibbet
after.text: Please, don't block my doorway. I'm swamped with work.

journal.text: Go to the toll house and take back Tibbet's shears.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Go to the toll house and take back Tibbet's shears.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk of Ulmgard: Fennick stuck to a railing, Pell in a hurry, Brannoc worried about the Undead.

rumour1.speaker: Fennick
rumour1.text: Help! Help! My tongue's stuck to the railing!

rumour2.speaker: Pell
rumour2.text: I'm due up on the wall at noon, sorry.

rumour3.speaker: Brannoc
rumour3.text: Beware! Those Undead grow bolder every night!

shop_greeting.specifics: Bodo of the Cold Kettle inn, Gorm the smith, Yorla the potion seller.

arms.speaker: Gorm
arms.text: Hard times, lad. I can't believe the Undead got as far as the Upper Gate. A black day indeed! Best buy what you need while I've still got it!

magic.speaker: Yorla
magic.text: Sorry, stranger, but my shelves are looking a bit bare. Cold weather makes folks drink up every potion in sight. Heh, heh, heh...

two_givers.specifics: Brannoc the beacon keeper wants the Signal Tower's beacon lit again; Krell, locked in the stocks for selling Warden Galmor his own horse, wants Hask's key.

offer_a.speaker: Brannoc
offer_a.text:
Greetings, Wanderer. I bring grave news. The beacon atop the Signal Tower has gone dark, and the Undead have crept up its stair.

If the beacon does not burn, the supply sleds from the valley will lose their way in the pass. Climb the tower on the north wall and light the fire. I will offer a worthy reward.

offer_b.speaker: Krell
offer_b.text:
Oh, bah! Don't just stand there gawking!

All right, all right, so I tried to sell the Warden his own horse. How was I supposed to know it was his? It looked like any other horse!

Hask keeps the key to these stocks in his hut at the Low Gate. Snatch it for me and I'll give you a fine mail shirt I've got stashed away.

outcome_a.speaker: Brannoc
outcome_a.text:
The beacon burns again! I can see it from the yard!

You have done Ulmgard a great service. Take this longsword, with our thanks. Now go and see Warden Galmor -- he will want to hear of this.

outcome_b.speaker: Krell
outcome_b.text:
Ha! Free! Oh, my poor ankles...

Here's the mail shirt, like I promised. Now I'm off before the Warden comes back!

journal_a.text: Fight your way up the Signal Tower and light its beacon for the supply sleds.

journal_b.text: Get the key from Hask's hut and free Krell.

rescue.specifics: Old Mildra's parrot Mungo flew out after a moth and the Ogres in the camp below the south cliff mean to bake him in a pie.

plea.speaker: Mildra
plea.text:
Oh, my Mungo! My poor Mungo! The Ogres have got him!

He flew out the window after a moth and the Ogres from the camp below the south cliff caught him in a sack. I heard them laughing about a pie! A pie!

Please, young sir, bring my bird home safe. I'm just an old woman. I can't go down there.

reminder.speaker: Mildra
reminder.text: Mungo is the dearest friend and sole comfort of my old age. Your trip down that cliff will show whether you have any heart at all.

found.speaker: Mungo
found.text: Awk! This road climbs to Ulmgard, the mighty frozen stronghold of the north!

following.speaker: Mungo
following.text: March up the ice stair. From there we climb past the stables and on to Warden Galmor's hall.

completion.speaker: Mildra
completion.text:
Mungo! My darling Mungo! You're home! Thank goodness!

Here, kind sir, take this spell book as a token of my appreciation. It's no use to an old woman like me.

main_opening.specifics: Pell points the newcomer to Warden Galmor, who gives the Upper Gate key and sends him after Ostrag the Necromancer in the Glacier Tombs.

herald.speaker: Pell
herald.text: Warden Galmor has bolted the Upper Gate until someone drives the Undead off the pass. I hope Master Dromund sent us somebody useful. The Warden usually just shouts at them from the wall instead of fighting them.

opening.speaker: Galmor
opening.text:
Ah! You must be the one Dromund promised me. Good! I need every pair of hands I can get.

The Necromancer Ostrag has raised the dead in the Glacier Tombs above the pass. His Undead swarm the high road and not a single sled has come through. I fear he means to take this fort next!

Here is the key to the Upper Gate. Go up through the gate, find Ostrag in the Tombs and put an end to him, lad. All of Ulmgard is counting on you.

journal.text: Seek out Ostrag the Necromancer in the Glacier Tombs above the Upper Gate.
